identitySignals: Name matches: an upholstery business called 'Supreme Interiors' operates at 2800 E. 8th Street, Oakland, CA 94601, and the agenda gives Oakland, CA.

The business's own contact page lists residential, commercial, auto and marine upholstery. A local trade business like this could plausibly host student work-based learning, but I found no page linking it to OUSD or the ECCCO program.
research.notes: Confidence is medium because no page confirms that this Oakland upholstery shop is the OUSD ECCCO Workplace Training Partner. Only the name and city match, and I did not find an OUSD or ECCCO mention on its site. I did not look up a California Secretary of State record, EIN or SAM.gov UEI, so those fields and the legal name are null. A BBB listing named 'Supreme Interiors Inc' suggests the legal name may include 'Inc', but I did not verify this. The contact page lists a second phone, (510) 536-3022, and the website link on it points to thesupremeinteriors.com. The website field uses supremeinteriors.com, the site I fetched. The email is a general business inbox. A reviewer should confirm that the vendor is this business before publishing.

profile.summary: Supreme Interiors is an upholstery shop in Oakland, California. It offers upholstery services for homes, businesses, cars and boats in the San Francisco Bay Area.
